analysis.title: Neon Green Financial Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark landing page uses a centered, oversized headline with luminous mint-green emphasis against a hazy mathematical background. Rounded controls, translucent navigation, and a persistent cookie panel soften the technical art direction while preserving strong contrast.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create an immersive abstract hero background for a dark financial technology landing page: near-black space with subtle forest-green haze, scattered glowing particles, faint floating mathematical equations and outlined geometric symbols, soft mint-green bloom concentrated behind the center, restrained cinematic depth, atmospheric grain, and ample negative space for white headline text. Use a premium editorial-tech composition, low contrast at the edges, crisp luminous accents, no logos, no brand marks, no readable words, no people, and no interface elements.
